blocks.content: Tourism-geography questions typically test which island/beach is associated with which feature (best beach, best diving spot, historic site etc.) — a table-based memorisation chapter.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: In 2018, Ross Island was renamed Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep, Neil Island became Shaheed Dweep, and Havelock Island was renamed Swaraj Dweep.
Radhanagar Beach on Swaraj Dweep (Havelock) holds Blue Flag certification and is a primary international tourist attraction.
Restricted Area Permits (RAP) and Protected Area Permits (PAP) regulate foreign and domestic visitor access to ecologically sensitive island zones.
Adventure and eco-tourism initiatives focus heavily on coral reef conservation, scuba diving, and sustainable mangrove exploration.

blocks.content: Sustainable island tourism balances ecological preservation of delicate coral ecosystems with historical and adventure landmark access.

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: Radhanagar Beach (Havelock/Swaraj Dweep) rated 'Asia's Best Beach' by TIME magazine in 2004 is one of the most repeated tourism one-liners for this UT.

items: Scuba diving and snorkelling hubs: Havelock/Swaraj Dweep, Neil/Shaheed Dweep, North Bay, Cinque Island, Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park.
Sea-walking and glass-bottom boat rides are popular non-diving ways to view coral reefs, mainly near North Bay and Havelock.
Trekking: Saddle Peak (North Andaman, highest point of the UT) and Mount Harriet are the principal trekking destinations.
Bioluminescence kayaking at night (visible glowing plankton) is a newer niche eco-tourism attraction, mainly around Havelock.
Light & Sound Show at Cellular Jail — a nightly heritage-tourism programme narrating the freedom-struggle history of the jail.
Match-the-following questions frequently test the revised names of Ross, Neil, and Havelock Islands.
Differentiate between volcanic island origin (Andaman & Nicobar) and coral atoll origin (Lakshadweep) in geography questions.
Remember that Barren Island is India's only active volcano, frequently asked in UPSC and SSC preliminary exams.
Restricted Area Permit (RAP) requirement for foreign nationals has been progressively eased for most tourist islands but continues to apply for tribal reserve areas and parts of the Nicobar district.
Entry to North Sentinel Island, and to designated tribal reserves of the Jarawa, Onge and Shompen, is completely prohibited for all tourists, domestic and foreign.
Photography or videography of the Jarawa (and other PVTGs) is a punishable offence under ANPATR — a fact frequently tested alongside the tribal-welfare chapter.
Radhanagar Beach, Swaraj Dweep (Havelock) — TIME magazine's 'Asia's Best Beach' (2004).
Ross & Smith Islands (Diglipur) are joined by a natural sandbar visible at low tide.
Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park gateway islands: Jolly Buoy and Red Skin (seasonal access).
Baratang Island is known for limestone caves and mud volcanoes, reached via the Jarawa Reserve stretch of the Andaman Trunk Road.
Photographing/filming the Jarawa or other PVTGs is a legal offence under ANPATR.
